title: AccuBlue® Broad Range RNA Quantitation
author: Ajit N Shah
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.87bhzin

steps.title: Warm all reagents
steps.instruction: Allow all components, including the RNA Broad Range Dye (provided in DMSO), to reach room temperature before use; note the dye may freeze when stored at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare working solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the RNA Broad Range Dye in RNA Broad Range Buffer at a 1:200 ratio to make 200 µL of working solution per sample; for example, mix 10 µL dye with 2 mL buffer in a plastic container and vortex or shake well. Scale volumes as needed.

steps.title: Aliquot working solution
steps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL of the prepared working solution into each clear 0.5 mL PCR tube designated for samples and standards.

steps.title: Add blanks, standards, samples
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of RNA Dilution Buffer (0 ng/µL) to one tube as the blank, 10 µL of RNA Broad Range Standard (100 ng/µL) to a second tube as the standard, and 10 µL of each RNA sample to its own tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL RNA Dilution Buffer (0 ng/µL) to tube 1 (blank).
Add 10 µL RNA Broad Range Standard (100 ng/µL) to tube 2 (standard).
Add 10 µL of each RNA sample to separate tubes.

steps.title: Incubate tubes
steps.instruction: Incubate all tubes at room temperature for at least 2 minutes.

steps.title: Run Qubit assay
steps.instruction: Turn on the Qubit® 3.0 instrument, select RNA on the home screen, choose the Broad Range assay, and follow the prompts: first read the blank tube (RNA Dilution Buffer), then read the standard tube (RNA Broad Range Standard); the software will use these values to quantify the unknown samples.

substeps.instruction: Select RNA and choose Broad Range assay.
Read the blank tube (RNA Dilution Buffer).
Read the standard tube (RNA Broad Range Standard).
Read each sample tube as prompted.

steps.title: Record results
steps.instruction: Record the quantified data manually or export it as a CSV file.
